_meta.why: That snapshot was captured at 5 promoted venues and declared 5 per-venue keys. The live surface now serves 15 venues and 8 per-venue keys (byAsset/byCallType/byTier arrived after it), so it had drifted into asserting a contract narrower than reality. It also used per_venue_allowed_keys, a field name build-knowledge-json.mjs does NOT read — so it published allowed_keys: [] into the PUBLIC knowledge bundle, a contract asserting nothing, silently. This one uses the projector's real field names.
_meta.promotion_note: WEEX promoted 2026-09-04T06:44:46Z under a dated operator override. Promotion is ADD-ONLY: a new venue appears as a new key with the SAME shape.
_meta.venue_status_filter: byExchange exposes status='promoted' venues only; shadow venues are NEVER public

error_contract.no_signals: 200 with byExchange {} — never 4xx for a valid GET
error_contract.note: PFE win-rate only. Phase-E outcome WR is INTERNAL and must never appear here (Data Integrity LAW).
